title: P1 msg.receive: request
description: Reading an inbox by code. With a job attempt token this is a long poll by the types from the type's inbox.read (like inbox_read): dispatching an entry of the report genus is a lease until the end of the attempt. With a worker token outside an attempt only the current values of state types from the role's receive are returned, without a lease (MSG-7).

types.description: Types from the task type's inbox.read; without the field, all such types.

wait_s.description: Waiting time of the long poll; the binding sets the upper bound.
